defaults.composition: One clear anchor sits in the middle ground on a third of the frame, the near bank or shallow water forms the foreground, and young green woodland or meadow recedes softly behind; the view looks sideways across the water

shots.subject: A moss-covered boulder in a clear brook, the water parting gently around it and young ferns unfurling on the bank behind
shots.motion_elements: the water parting around the boulder and the young fern fronds stirring

shots.subject: A simple plank footbridge spanning a narrow stream, fresh grass on both banks and a young birch leaning over the water
shots.motion_elements: the stream flowing under the footbridge and the birch leaves fluttering

shots.subject: A small two-step waterfall in a beech wood stream, warm low light on the falling water and pale new beech leaves above
shots.motion_elements: the falling water and the beech leaves stirring

shots.subject: A clump of yellow marsh marigolds on a wet bank beside a slow stream, soft grey light and gentle ripples beyond
shots.motion_elements: the gentle ripples beyond the bank and the marsh marigold leaves moving

shots.subject: An old low mossy stone wall ending at the edge of a brook, rain-darkened stones, fresh grass at its foot and dripping hazel branches overhead
shots.motion_elements: the brook flowing past the wall and the hazel branches dripping

shots.subject: A willow bowing over a still pond, its long new-leafed fronds touching the water and faint mist across the surface
shots.motion_elements: the willow fronds swaying and the faint mist across the pond

shots.subject: A cluster of young reeds and yellow flag iris leaves in the shallows of a pond, clear water and a sunny bank behind
shots.motion_elements: the reeds and iris leaves swaying and the ripples in the shallows

shots.subject: A flowering blackthorn bush on a grassy stream bank, its white blossom backlit by low sun and the slow water glinting below
shots.motion_elements: the blossom stirring and the glinting water

shots.subject: A woodland stream running over flat grey slate ledges between young ferns and wood sorrel, with wet stone and a mossy oak trunk behind
shots.motion_elements: the water running over the slate ledges and the fern fronds moving

shots.subject: A spring bubbling up into a small pool among mossy stones, with wet ferns, fresh green grass and a young hazel around it
shots.motion_elements: the spring bubbling up and the ferns trembling

shots.subject: A short bend of a meadow brook with buttercups on the inner bank and dew on the grass, early mist lying low on the water
shots.motion_elements: the low mist on the water and the buttercups nodding

shots.subject: A fallen mossy log lying across a narrow stream, young beech saplings behind and dappled light on the moving water
shots.motion_elements: the stream flowing beneath the log and the beech leaves fluttering

shots.subject: A grassy bank under a wild cherry tree in bloom, a few fallen petals on the slow stream and warm light on the trunk
shots.motion_elements: the slow stream carrying the petals and the blossom stirring

shots.subject: A small natural rock weir across a lowland stream, water pouring over it in a smooth sheet and young alder leaves hanging above
shots.motion_elements: the smooth sheet of water and the alder leaves moving

shots.subject: A hawthorn branch in white blossom hanging over a slow brook, wet petals, a grassy bank and a soft reflection in the water
shots.motion_elements: the hawthorn blossom swaying and the soft reflection rippling

shots.subject: A shallow pebble ford in a stream with a band of sunlight crossing the water and young hazel bushes on the far bank
shots.motion_elements: the water rippling over the pebbles and the hazel leaves stirring

shots.subject: A patch of water crowfoot with small white flowers floating on a clear stream, long green fronds streaming in the current
shots.motion_elements: the long fronds streaming in the current

shots.subject: A young birch on a small grassy island in a pond, its tiny new leaves glowing in low sun and its reflection on the water
shots.motion_elements: the birch leaves fluttering and the reflection rippling

shots.subject: A tumble of mossy boulders where a hill stream drops into a pool, ferns and wood anemones on the bank
shots.motion_elements: the stream dropping into the pool and the ferns stirring

shots.subject: A clear pool below a short cascade between mossy rocks, wet pale primroses on the stones beside it and young ferns along the bank
shots.motion_elements: the short cascade and the ripples spreading across the pool

shots.subject: Lily pads just unfurling on a calm pond with a stand of young sedges on the right and soft mist beyond
shots.motion_elements: the soft mist and the sedges swaying

shots.subject: A low dry stone wall running beside a brook, Queen Anne's lace along its foot and the water sparkling in daylight
shots.motion_elements: the sparkling brook and the Queen Anne's lace heads nodding

shots.subject: A gentle riffle in a lowland stream catching warm low light, bordered by fresh grass and an old willow trunk
shots.motion_elements: the rippling riffle and the grass moving

shots.subject: A small rustic wooden fence post line along a pond edge, reeds and new grass at its feet and calm grey water
shots.motion_elements: the reeds swaying and the calm water rippling

shots.subject: A narrow stream bend under young beech trees after rain, wet leaves dripping and the water flowing clear over brown stones
shots.motion_elements: the stream flowing over the stones and the dripping leaves

shots.subject: A shallow spring pool with bright green watercress and a thin trickle of water flowing in, early pale sun on the bank
shots.motion_elements: the trickle flowing in and the watercress leaves moving

shots.subject: Bluebells on a shady bank beside a slow woodland stream, young beech trunks and dappled light shifting on the water
shots.motion_elements: the dappled light shifting on the water and the bluebell stems nodding

shots.subject: A small sandy beach on a stream bend with a young alder leaning over and warm light on the shallow water
shots.motion_elements: the shallow water flowing and the alder leaves stirring

shots.subject: A mossy boulder in the middle of a broad shallow stream with smooth water streaming past and pale willows behind
shots.motion_elements: the smooth water streaming past and the willow leaves moving

shots.subject: An old apple tree in white and pink blossom leaning over a stream at an orchard edge, wet petals on the grass and soft clouds clearing
shots.motion_elements: the apple blossom stirring and the stream flowing

shots.subject: A small natural spring trickling from between mossy stones into a fern-lined pool, with pale morning light on the moss
shots.motion_elements: the trickle of water and the fern fronds stirring

shots.subject: A rippling meander of a meadow stream with a bank of fresh grass and a young hawthorn in new leaf on the far side
shots.motion_elements: the rippling meander and the hawthorn leaves stirring
